description: Midlertidige flomsoner for Mjøsa for Hamar, Stange og Ringsaker is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stange kommune. Datasettet viser flomsoner for 20-, 200- og 1000-årsflom for Mjøsa for kommunene Hamar, Stange og Ringsaker. Flomsonene er generert på bakgrunn av ny flomberegning gjort av NVE i 2022 og flomhøydene inneholder sikkerhetsmargin på 30cm. Datasettet er midlertidig generert for kommunene Hamar, Stange og Ringsaker i påvente av nye flomsoner fra NVE. Coverage: Stange kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Stange kommune. Its keywords include fellesDatakatalog, Stange kommune, Ringsaker kommune, Samfunnssikkerhet, Local, Det offentlige kartgrunnlaget. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2022-03-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
